collection_accounting.note: a missed window has no forecasts at all, and an actual starter who was not the probable starter has no forecast and no outcome row; both are counted here

note: Accuracy only, alongside the pure_gate compare results; never evidence of betting value.

full_eligible.reason: 8 game clusters < 20: CIs unstable, read descriptively only

pregame_market_listed.reason: 7 game clusters < 20: CIs unstable, read descriptively only

scorecard.metric_policy: point metrics use the forecast mean (MAE of the median reported too); scale-dependent metrics are per sport:statistic only; CRPS = 2 x mean pinball loss over published quantile levels (ladder variant: midpoint-rule threshold decomposition over the ladder's range); PIT is interval-censored from the published knots; Brier and log score per ladder rung; RPS = sum of rung Brier scores; head-to-head on identical (identity, as_of) rows using only the knots both arms publish, deltas are challenger minus comparator, percentile bootstrap resampling whole clusters
scorecard.note: Accuracy only. Never evidence of betting value (see value_scorecard). Promotion needs a preregistered, untouched chronological holdout.

pit.note: interval-censored PIT: each row's PIT is only known to lie in [L, U] given its published knots, and its unit mass is spread uniformly over that interval. Uniform in expectation for a calibrated forecast. The chi-square p-value assumes independent rows; rows from one game are correlated, so read it as optimistic

pregame_market_listed.definition: identities with a market-family listing that opened and was observed by our own records at or before the forecast's as_of (pregame records only, never settlement)

scorecard.metric_policy: point metrics use the forecast mean (MAE of the median reported too); scale-dependent metrics are per sport:statistic only; CRPS = 2 x mean pinball loss over published quantile levels (ladder variant: midpoint-rule threshold decomposition over the ladder's range); PIT is interval-censored from the published knots; Brier and log score per ladder rung; RPS = sum of rung Brier scores; head-to-head on identical (identity, as_of) rows using only the knots both arms publish, deltas are challenger minus comparator, percentile bootstrap resampling whole clusters
scorecard.note: Accuracy only. Never evidence of betting value (see value_scorecard). Promotion needs a preregistered, untouched chronological holdout.
